grantSourceReason: one capability (no-write-deps) was dropped and the resulting grant was verified in the real jail by a single arm

notRedirected.why: the jail leaves HOME/USERPROFILE alone — `build_jail.rs` sandbox_homes() reads the ambient value and `compiler/defaults.rs` BASELINE_ENV_EXACT passes it through — so there is no private jail home to reproduce and redirecting one would measure an environment no confined script sees
